transcript.content: Good morning, this is Daniel Reyes from Northgate Bank’s fraud prevention team. We’ve detected a suspicious payment on your account and need to verify your identity right away. Could you please confirm your full name and date of birth?
Sure, my name is Alex Morgan and I was born on 4 May.
Thank you, Alex. To complete the verification, could you please provide the last four digits of your Social Security number?
Thank you for confirming that, Alex. To finish the verification, could you please share the last four digits of your Social Security number?
Your account will be frozen unless you act now, so stay on the line and do not hang up or call anyone else.
Okay, I'll stay on the line.
Your session is still active and we need to verify your account immediately. Could you please read the one‑time code that was just sent to your phone out loud?
Okay, the code is on my screen. I'll read it out now.
Thank you, Alex. Please read the six‑digit code now so we can complete the verification.
Thank you, Alex. Please transfer the funds to the secure account so we can finalize the verification.
